description: The agent must: (1) Read the raw data files in market_data/commodities/gold/ — including the messy CSV with ERR rows (xau_usd_20250708.csv), the previous day close file (xau_usd_20250707_close.txt), the domestic JSON (domestic_gold_20250708.json), and the market factors text file. (2) Compute derived metrics: international change = 3344.65 - 3298.30 = +46.35 USD (+1.41%), domestic change = 782.50 - 765.30 = +17.20 CNY/gram. (3) Follow the SKILL.md output structure exactly, including: the 📊 **【今日金价速报】** header, OHLC fields for XAU/USD, the 📰 market factors section covering USD/DXY, Fed rate outlook, and geopolitical risk, the 💡 investment advice section with all three risk tiers (保守型/稳健型/激进型) using the SKILL.md-specified allocation percentages (10-20% for 稳健型, 20-30% for 激进型), annotating data source and date, and including the mandatory disclaimer '市场有风险，投资需谨慎'. Agents relying only on generic knowledge will miss the proprietary 3-tier framework with specific percentages and the mandatory Chinese disclaimer phrase.
